poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on the fighting stopping this year, not a forecast of it.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.recent: The first Russia-Ukraine peace talks in 9 months opened in Abu Dhabi, where the US pushed a new Europe security framework and the EU had already rebuffed Trump's deal covering all of Europe. TASS then carried that Putin is not ready to make peace in Abu Dhabi, while Russian strikes cut power to about 850,000 people and hit cargo ships off Odesa.

stocks:6818.HK.standing: A Beijing-based commercial bank controlled by the state-owned China Everbright Group, with shares listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai. Its loan book makes it a gauge of how China's mid-sized lenders are faring.
stocks:6818.HK.recent: The fortnight's one story about the bank itself was a bribery case: a former Everbright executive and their spouse took 4.29 million yuan in bribes disguised as salaries. It broke on the last day of the window, after the shares had already risen, and accounts for none of the move.

stocks:2357.TW.standing: The Taipei maker of Asus laptops, motherboards, graphics cards and ROG gaming hardware, listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange. It buys memory and chips it does not make, so its margins sit downstream of component prices.

wiki-china.standing: How many people open Wikipedia's article on China each day: a rough gauge of how often the world's second-largest economy and most populous one-party state pulls general readers toward the basics.
wiki-china.recent: China's news this fortnight was about trade and technology rather than one event. The country imported nearly 42 million tons of crude in October, the Pentagon delisted WuXi AppTec to comply with a court ruling, and a Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite a US ban. None of it accounts for the late-October peak.

poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Houthis and Saudi Arabia agree a ceasefire before the year ends. Its price is what traders will pay on the war between Yemen's Houthi movement and the kingdom ending, and so on Red Sea and Gulf oil risk.
poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.recent: The war came inside the kingdom: Houthis claimed 6 strikes on Saudi Arabia, debris from intercepted missiles blew out windows across Aramco Tower in Riyadh, and an unclaimed attack set the East-West pipeline ablaze. Houthis said Saudi-led strikes killed 27 villagers, and Syrian military trainers began working inside Saudi Arabia.

stocks:6301.T.standing: Japan's largest maker of construction and mining machinery, and the world's second after Caterpillar. Its excavators and haul trucks sell on mining investment and building activity, so its orders read the global capital-spending cycle.

stocks:7203.T.standing: Japan's largest company and the world's biggest carmaker by vehicles sold, listed in Tokyo. Most of its sales are abroad, so its profits, and its share price, swing with the yen and with tariffs on cars entering the United States.

wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.standing: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps is Iran's parallel military, founded after the 1979 revolution and answerable to the Supreme Leader. It runs the missile force, a navy in the Gulf and a large business empire.
wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.recent: Paris prosecutors said the Revolutionary Guards had hacked freezers in 700 French supermarkets, and France summoned Iran's envoy. US prosecutors then charged three alleged Iran-backed operatives over Fairford, linking them to nearly 20 attacks, while Iran listed Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist organisations.

stocks:GEV.standing: The power-equipment maker spun off from General Electric in 2024, building gas and wind turbines and grid gear. Its gas-turbine order book is one of the clearest reads on how fast utilities are adding generation.

stocks:9502.T.standing: The utility that supplies electricity to Nagoya and central Japan's manufacturing belt, home to Toyota. It owns the Hamaoka nuclear plant in Shizuoka and half of JERA, Japan's largest power generator and fuel buyer.

stocks:9983.T.standing: The Tokyo-listed parent of Uniqlo, Asia's largest clothing retailer, which now earns more than half its sales abroad. It carries a heavy weight in the price-weighted Nikkei 225, so its share moves Japan's benchmark more than almost any other.
stocks:9983.T.recent: Uniqlo reversed a sock price increase within days, a sign of how quickly Japanese shoppers push back on higher prices. That retreat came after the last close shown, and nothing reported in the fortnight accounts for the share's rise.

wiki-united-states.standing: Daily reads of English Wikipedia's article on the United States, one of its most-visited country pages. It rises when American power or politics becomes the world's story, not only America's.
wiki-united-states.recent: Vance blamed the Iran war for the midterm defeat, calling it 'the reason we lost', and clashed with Trump over the result. Iran threats moved Bessent onto a military base, with at least 7 US officials out of their homes, and the Supreme Court cleared the Big Bend wall over a lone dissent from Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson.

stocks:TFG.JO.standing: A Cape Town-based clothing, jewellery and homeware retailer listed in Johannesburg, behind chains such as Foschini, Markham and @home, with businesses in Britain and Australia. Its sales track South African household budgets.

poly-next-us-iran-senior-diplomatic-meet.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if senior US and Iranian officials meet in person before its deadline. Its price is what traders will stake on direct talks between two governments that have rarely sat at one table.
poly-next-us-iran-senior-diplomatic-meet.recent: Tehran denied any talks with Washington: Rezaei said Iran had seven conditions and no answer, then tied reopening the Strait of Hormuz to that answer after the Revolutionary Guards said tankers hit mines. In Washington, Trump held off strikes at Gulf neighbours' request while Bessent was moved to a military base over Iranian threats.

stocks:CAT.standing: The world's largest maker of construction and mining machinery, and a major builder of engines, turbines and generators. Its order book tracks spending on mines, roads, oil and gas, and on-site power for data centres.

stocks:BX.standing: The New York firm that is the world's largest alternative asset manager, running private equity, property, credit and hedge-fund money for pensions and endowments. Its share price tracks deal-making and the value of private assets.

stocks:0100.HK.standing: A Shanghai-based artificial intelligence lab that builds large language, video and voice models, listed in Hong Kong. Its shares are a direct price on one of China's challengers to the American AI labs.
stocks:0100.HK.recent: The one story about MiniMax in this window was its listing of 16 openings in San Francisco, part of a push by Chinese AI labs to hire Americans; nothing in it accounts for the fall in its shares.

stocks:SGRO.L.standing: A UK real estate investment trust and one of Europe's largest landlords of warehouses and industrial estates, Slough's among them. It also builds data centres, so its rents follow logistics demand and grid power.

stocks:PLD.standing: The world's largest owner of logistics warehouses, a US real estate investment trust leasing distribution space near ports and cities. Its rents and occupancy track how much goods trade and online retail need storing.

stocks:RWE.DE.standing: Shares in RWE, Germany's largest power producer, listed in Frankfurt. It is pivoting from lignite and gas plants to wind and solar, so the stock trades on European power prices, carbon costs and the pace of that build-out.

stocks:HEI.DE.standing: One of the world's largest makers of cement and aggregates, based in Heidelberg, Germany. Cement is carbon-heavy, so its shares answer to construction demand and to the price of EU emissions permits.

stocks:KOG.OL.standing: Norway's largest defence contractor, half-owned by the Norwegian state, maker of the NASAMS air-defence system and naval strike missiles. Its share moves on European defence budgets and on orders from NATO governments.

stocks:2359.HK.standing: A Chinese contract research and manufacturing company, listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong, that makes drug ingredients and runs lab work for Western pharmaceutical firms. Its share price tracks how far Washington lets that dependence run.
stocks:2359.HK.recent: The Pentagon dropped WuXi AppTec from its 'Chinese military companies' list to comply with a court ruling. That entry would have opened the way to naming it a biotech 'company of concern' under the BIOSECURE push, the step that decides whether US drugmakers can keep it as a supplier.

wiki-anthropic.standing: Anthropic is the San Francisco artificial-intelligence company that builds the Claude models. Former OpenAI researchers founded it, and it sells its models to businesses and developers in competition with OpenAI and Google.
wiki-anthropic.recent: Anthropic filed to go public, and the filing showed an $80.7 billion first-half loss. As the IPO roadshow started, Google and Nvidia each bought $10 billion of Anthropic, and the company released Fable and Mythos 5.2, which are the same model. In between, Cat Wu, who led Claude Code, left for OpenAI.

stocks:SBK.JO.standing: Africa's largest lender by assets, based in Johannesburg and operating across some 20 African countries. China's ICBC owns about a fifth of it, making it a main conduit for Chinese trade and lending on the continent.

stocks:S68.SI.standing: The company that runs Singapore's stock and derivatives exchanges and their clearing houses. Much of its income comes from futures on Asian assets, from Chinese equities to iron ore, so trading volume drives its earnings.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.standing: A Polymarket contract on Anthropic, the AI lab behind the Claude models: it pays out if the company's market value at the close of its first day of public trading is below $1.25 trillion.

stocks:BP.standing: American shares of BP, the London-based oil and gas major that produces crude and gas, refines it and sells fuel worldwide. Its earnings rise and fall with oil prices and refining margins.
stocks:BP.recent: BP reported a surge in profit on a refining windfall, a lift for O'Neill's turnaround, and analysts expect eight oil majors to make over $350bn in operating cash between them. Neither the results nor the cash explains the slide in the shares that followed.

stocks:XOM.standing: America's largest oil company, pumping crude and gas from the Permian Basin to Guyana's offshore fields and refining fuel and chemicals worldwide. Its shares track oil and gas prices more closely than the wider market.

poly-will-bola-tinubu-win-the-2027-niger.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Bola Tinubu wins Nigeria's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay on a second term for the president of Africa's most populous country.

poly-will-david-lisnard-win-the-2027-fre.standing: What traders will pay for a contract that pays out if David Lisnard, the centre-right mayor of Cannes, wins France's 2027 presidential election. It prices his chances in a crowded field on the right.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: A contract that pays out if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei. The capital has mostly elected Kuomintang mayors, so this is what traders will pay on the DPP taking it.

poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve leaves its policy rate unchanged at its January 2027 meeting. Its price is what traders will pay for a pause, and it moves on inflation data and on what Fed officials say in public.
poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.recent: Core consumer prices rose 0.3% in October, and the Fed's Logan called for two more rate hikes, possibly rapidly. Waller and other Fed speakers turned hawkish too. Two-year Treasury yields jumped 18 basis points as bonds priced the risk of a half-point hike in December, and a bet on the Fed sitting still in January lost its buyers.

stocks:7202.T.standing: The Japanese maker of commercial trucks, pickups and diesel engines, listed in Tokyo. Thailand is its pickup base, so its shares move with the yen and with freight and farm demand across Southeast Asia.

stocks:MSFT.standing: Shares in the maker of Windows, Office and the Azure cloud, one of the world's most valuable companies. Its OpenAI stake and its data-centre spending make it a bellwether for whether the AI build-out pays.
stocks:MSFT.recent: Kaspersky found a bootkit, BlackX, getting past Secure Boot on fully patched Windows machines, and protesters stormed a planned Microsoft site over Gaza. Neither explains the share price. Microsoft passed Nvidia in market cap on a day Nvidia fell 6.27%, not on gains of its own.

stocks:TTE.standing: France's largest oil and gas company, producing crude and LNG from Africa to the Middle East and the North Sea, and building a power business. This line is its New York listing, priced in dollars.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Israel-Iran ceasefire is still holding on 31 December. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on every strike, threat and report of talks.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Gadi Eisenkot, recommended by 67 lawmakers to Netanyahu's 46, is forming Israel's next government and warned the caretaker prime minister against military moves without an immediate threat. In Washington, Trump held off Iran strikes after Gulf neighbours asked him to, and Vance blamed the war for the midterm defeat.

wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Benjamin Netanyahu, Likud's leader and Israel's longest-serving prime minister. He has shaped Israeli politics, and its wars and its courts, for three decades.
wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.recent: The vote count left Netanyahu without a majority. Shin Bet rejected his claim of Arab voter fraud, the Joint List's 19 seats swung behind Eisenkot, and 67 of 120 Knesset members recommended his rival against his 46. Eisenkot now has 28 days to build a coalition, while Netanyahu, as caretaker, still commands the security services.

wiki-nvidia.standing: Nvidia, the Santa Clara chip designer whose graphics processors run most of the world's AI training, and one of the most valuable companies on earth. Its fortunes carry the chip sector and the data-centre build-out with them.
wiki-nvidia.recent: US officials said Chinese intelligence targeted Jensen Huang through Megaspeed's Alice Huang, whose employer reportedly bought $4.8bn of Nvidia equipment. The board opened an inquiry into the affair, House committees sought a closed briefing on 18 November, Sen. Cramer called for resignation, and reports followed that the board may oust Jensen Huang.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-on-november-19-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab that makes Claude, lists its shares publicly on November 19, 2026. A listing would put a public market price on one of the leading AI developers for the first time.

stocks:SCC.BK.standing: Thailand's largest industrial group, listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand and part-owned by the Crown Property Bureau. It makes cement, building materials, petrochemicals and packaging across Southeast Asia.
stocks:SCC.BK.recent: The one development on the company's own business came after the latest close: SCG said its core plastics plant in Vietnam, knocked out by the Hormuz disruption, stays shut until mid-2027. Nothing in the input accounts for the slide before that.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Crude oil and the fuels refined from it: petrol, diesel, jet fuel and the feedstock for plastics. It supplies about a third of the world's energy, and its price runs through transport, food and inflation almost everywhere.
wiki-petroleum.recent: October closed with Brent up about 15% on the month, its fourth straight gain, as the US threatened Iran over Hormuz. Then supply swamped the fear: Saudi Arabia reported output up 26%, JP Morgan put the October surplus at 1.4 million barrels a day, and Brent fell below $90 for the first time since August, even after Houthi missiles damaged Aramco Tower in Riyadh.

poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2028. Impeachment takes only a simple House majority, so the price lives on who controls the chamber.

wiki-data-center.standing: A building full of servers, storage and network equipment, with the power and cooling to run them around the clock. They host cloud computing and AI training, which turns their electricity and water use into local politics.
wiki-data-center.recent: After household power bills in Ohio rose over 20% in two years, data centers went onto the midterm ballot, and voters rejected them in 38 of 40-plus contests. Hinojosa's win in Texas left that state's projects uncertain. Chip stocks then fell, Nvidia 6%, AMD 12% and Micron 11%, and over 100 groups planned data-centre protests across Europe.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $1.75 trillion or more by Dec 31. It is a bet on whether a new funding round or share sale sets that mark before the year ends.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the Florida Republican and former senator, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will stake on that outcome, in cents on the dollar.
poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.recent: Trump's side took a blowout defeat in the midterm election, and JD Vance publicly blamed the Iran war for it and clashed with Trump over the result. None of it named Marco Rubio, and none of it accounts for this contract's drift.

stocks:IBM.standing: International Business Machines, the century-old American computing company, now earns most of its money from hybrid-cloud software, Red Hat and mainframes sold to banks and governments, with a consulting arm alongside.
stocks:IBM.recent: The one development in its own business is a plan to link two 520-qubit chips into a 1,040-qubit system that users can reach in 2027, a step on its roadmap to error-corrected quantum computers before 2030. That was announced after the latest close, so it does not explain the share's climb.

poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and Oman, the two states on either shore of the Strait of Hormuz, reach an agreement on the strait by November 30. The price is what traders pay for a yes.
poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.recent: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf said Tehran and Muscat had agreed the strait's shipping lanes, but the claim came through Russian state news agency TASS and Oman has not confirmed it. The same day the Revolutionary Guards said three tankers hit mines, and Rezaei tied reopening the strait to Washington's answer to Iran's seven conditions.

poly-will-anthropic-have-the-best-ai-mod.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic's model ranks first on a public AI leaderboard at the end of November 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on Anthropic beating OpenAI, Google and xAI at the top.

stocks:TMUS.standing: One of the three national mobile carriers in the United States, majority-owned by Deutsche Telekom since it absorbed Sprint in 2020. Its subscriber fight with Verizon and AT&T carries much of the German parent's value.
stocks:TMUS.recent: New York accused T-Mobile of throttling the internet service it sells to low-income households to 600 Kbps. A state charge against its own business is a cost, not a lift, and nothing else in the input accounts for the share climbing to its high the same day.

poly-jensen-huang-announced-resignation-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jensen Huang leaves the chief executive post at Nvidia, the chipmaker he co-founded and has run since 1993, before the end of 2026. It prices succession risk at the company that supplies most AI chips.
poly-jensen-huang-announced-resignation-.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's news concerned Jensen Huang's job. The only Polymarket item was the company's pledge to return $3.9 million to victims of a site compromise, and that does not account for the bet.

stocks:UAL.standing: The parent of United Airlines, one of the three largest US carriers, with hubs in Chicago, Newark and San Francisco. Its shares move on jet fuel costs, business-travel demand and its transatlantic and Pacific routes.
stocks:UAL.recent: The fortnight's news about United concerned its own policies, not its earnings: it barred AI agents such as OpenAI's dots from booking its flights, and its CEO doubted Boom's supersonic airliner would be ready by 2029. Neither accounts for the share price, and the ban came after the high.

stocks:LUV.standing: The share price of Southwest Airlines, the largest US domestic carrier by passengers, built on a single Boeing 737 fleet and point-to-point routes. It moves with jet fuel costs and with how full planes on US routes are.

poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran sign a final agreement on Iran's nuclear programme before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay on that outcome, not a forecast.
poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.recent: Tehran says there are no talks with Washington: Rezaei set out conditions, got no answer, and now ties reopening the Strait of Hormuz, where three tankers hit mines, to that reply. Trump held strikes at Gulf neighbours' request, while US prosecutors charged three alleged Iran-backed operatives and Bessent moved onto a military base after threats.

poly-variational-fdv-above-800m-one-day-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Variational token's fully diluted valuation, meaning its price times every token that will ever exist, tops $800 million the day after it launches. Variational is a crypto trading platform.

poly-will-nvidia-be-the-largest-company-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether NVIDIA will be the world's most valuable listed company by market capitalisation on 31 December. It is a bet on the AI chip trade holding its lead over the other trillion-dollar tech giants.

poly-ai-industry-downturn-by-december-31.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the AI boom ends in a crash before the close of 2026. It is a running wager against the spending on chips, data centres and models that has carried the largest technology stocks.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on bitcoin, the first cryptocurrency: a digital currency with no central issuer, launched in 2009. Surges mark the moments the coin reaches people outside the trading world.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: The fortnight's events came after the mid-October peak and do not account for it. Hackers linked to North Korea took at least $5.9 billion from Binance, by Chainalysis's count. Spot bitcoin ETFs then lost a net $1.282 billion in a week, and MSCI dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes.

stocks:BIDU.standing: China's largest search engine, whose New York-listed shares also price its bets on Ernie AI models, Kunlun chips and Apollo Go robotaxis.
stocks:BIDU.recent: Baidu's own news in the window was product work: an AI agent in Wuhan that turns residents' group chats into work orders, and a world model built in Shenzhen to train robotaxis in simulation. None of it accounts for the share price.

stocks:MSTR.standing: The former MicroStrategy, a business-software firm that became the largest listed holder of bitcoin, buying it by selling its own shares and debt. Its stock trades as a leveraged bet on the coin.
stocks:MSTR.recent: Bitcoin fell below $76K as an AI stock rout hit Strategy, Coinbase and Circle, taking the value of its 850,364 bitcoin down with it. MSCI then ruled that a company whose business is buying bitcoin is a fund and confirmed it will drop it from its indexes. Index funds must sell, and a model that sells shares and debt to buy more bitcoin loses its passive buyers.

stocks:MSCI.standing: The New York-listed firm behind the MSCI World and Emerging Markets indexes, which it licenses to fund managers with risk analytics and ESG ratings. Its fees scale with the money tracking those indexes.
stocks:MSCI.recent: The one MSCI story came after the chart's last day. MSCI ruled that Strategy, whose business is buying bitcoin, is a fund rather than an operating company, and dropped it from its indexes. Nothing reported explains the earlier rise.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-by-november-20-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, lists its shares on a public exchange by November 20, 2026. A listing would put a public price on one of the largest private AI companies.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance, Donald Trump's vice president, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it tracks the fortunes of the heir to Trump's movement.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.recent: The bets turned after Trump's crushing midterm election defeat, a blowout that Axios called a blue tsunami breaking MAGA. Vance then clashed with Trump over the loss and blamed it publicly on the Iran war, while Trump made Defense Secretary Hegseth pay for the debacle.

poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran agree a ceasefire by November 22. Its price is what traders will pay for a dollar if that happens, so it tracks how the war's diplomacy is read day to day.
poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.recent: Trump held off resuming strikes after Gulf neighbours asked him to hold fire. Netanyahu has pressed him almost daily to restart the bombing, and one of their calls turned into a shouting match, with Trump as the brake. Against that, Tehran denies any talks with Washington and says its 7 conditions have gone unanswered.

stocks:C.standing: The New York-based bank with the widest overseas reach of America's largest lenders. Its treasury and trade arm moves cash for multinationals across dozens of countries, so its shares respond to global trade and interest rates.

wiki-renminbi.standing: China's currency, whose unit is the yuan. The People's Bank of China sets a daily midpoint and lets it trade only within a band around it, so its path is a policy choice that reaches exporters' margins and trading partners' prices.
wiki-renminbi.recent: Beijing set out a plan to price shipping risk in yuan, aiming at a market where 12 London clubs insure 87% of ocean-going tonnage. It followed a PBOC fixing set weaker to slow a rally that has lifted the yuan 9% on the euro and squeezed exporters in Ningbo; Citi now forecasts 6.5 per dollar by mid-2027.

stocks:SPCX.standing: The rocket and satellite company Elon Musk founded. It flies most of the world's orbital launches and runs Starlink, the largest satellite internet network, and its military Starshield variant makes it a defence contractor too.
stocks:SPCX.recent: The low came as SpaceX's default risk hit a fresh peak in a tech-led selloff and Elon Musk's political bet failed. SpaceX was also weighing a merger with Tesla. In Kyiv, Zelensky said Starshield again cuts off anything above 161 km/h.

stocks:9984.T.standing: SoftBank Group is the Tokyo-listed holding company Masayoshi Son built. Its value rests mainly on stakes in other companies, chiefly the chip designer Arm and its bets on AI, so its share price moves with the price of AI.
stocks:9984.T.recent: Over the fortnight SoftBank signed Sceye to fly stratospheric cell towers over Japan. Then, after the low, it booked more than $3 billion in losses on turbine deposits meant for AI power from natural gas. Neither event explains the fall in the share.

stocks:WHL.JO.standing: A Johannesburg-listed retailer that runs the Woolworths stores in South Africa, selling premium food, clothing and homeware, plus Country Road Group in Australia. Its food arm is a gauge of what the middle class still spends.
stocks:WHL.JO.recent: Woolworths reported that turnover at Woolworths Foods grew only 1.9% and concession sales just 0.1%. That is a sharp slowdown in the food business the group relies on to sell to South Africa's middle class, and the shares fell on the figures.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if the Federal Reserve lifts its policy rate by a quarter point at its first decision after January 2027. Its price moves on US inflation prints and on what Fed officials say.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: October's inflation report reset the bet: core consumer prices rose 0.3%, and the Fed's Logan then called for two more rate hikes, possibly rapidly. Two-year Treasury yields jumped as talk turned to a 50 bps move, while commentators faulted Warsh's mixed messages after the Fed held rates in October.

poly-will-pablo-hernandez-de-cos-be-the-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Pablo Hernández de Cos, the former Bank of Spain governor, succeeds Christine Lagarde at the European Central Bank, which sets interest rates for the twenty countries that use the euro.
